verses.text: The oppressor and the deceiver, for the one who leads astray the way of the Creator, the devil, shall be cast down in the latter days, and the beautiful and precious islands of Egypt shall rejoice in their coming.
He shall be cast down; and in his heart he shall be humbled, and his glory shall return to the earth and to the dust.

And he said, "Who is above me? For I shall descend to the depths of the sea, and I shall ascend to the heavens; I shall not be restrained by the depths, and I shall carry the children of Adam as a bird carries its fledglings."

Because I have created them for the sake of the law of the Lord, and because they have not kept the command of the Lord, I shall protect those who dwell upon the earth, and there is none who can take them from my hand.
Together with me, they shall go to destruction; I shall return them to the way that has become desolate.

"Therefore, those who love him, and those who keep the law, shall seek me; but those who have turned away from their Lord shall come to me; they shall love me, and they shall keep my covenant; and I shall rend their hearts that they may not return to their Creator, and I shall seize their thoughts."

When I have shown them the riches of this world, I shall turn their hearts away from the way of the Lord; when I have shown them beautiful women and adornments, I shall protect them from the way of the Lord.
When they behold the treasures of gold and silver, they shall return to my work, and thus I shall protect them from the way of the Lord.

When they see fine garments, white linen and red garments, ornaments and shoes, I shall protect them from the way of the Lord; and I shall return their thoughts to me; when I have shown them wealth and abundance, I shall return them to my work.
Concerning women, concerning anger and concerning pride, when they behold the snares of arrogance, in all these I shall return them to my way.
And I will show signs unto them in the time of their affliction; I will reveal unto them a sign that is in their heart; and I will make manifest the sign of their words unto them.

I will show a sign unto those who dwell in my abode; whether it be in the movement of the stars, or in the coming forth of the clouds, or in the burning of fire, or in the cry of beasts and birds, for they are the dwellers in this place, and in all these I will reveal signs unto their hearts.
They shall speak and give a sign unto their spouses; and I too will be a sign unto them as I was before, as they have spoken unto them.

"Let the people who have been warned heed, and let them give heed to the price; for they shall know the prophecy that is spoken unto them, discerning between good and evil, and all shall be as they have spoken, and as their words shall be done, as the words of the prophets and as the words of the seers shall not be lacking, and they shall speak unto their spouses, and I will perform the sign of their words."

Those who perish, and those who are my spouses shall multiply; and the children of Adam shall perish with me; and when they have spoken this, I shall rejoice; for I will not forsake the lowly, for I have lifted them up because of their fathers, because of Adam, I have exalted them.
"And I too will bring all my children who walk in my commandment unto destruction," those who have been warned shall be cast into the fire with me, for I have a covenant with God.

And when my anger is kindled against me, and it is poured out unto hell and unto the pit, in that time, I will say, "My Lord; my Creator, in this time I have been seized, and in your sanctuary I have been made desolate, and in your appointed time I have been made desolate; O my Lord, before you I will speak one thing, grant me permission."

And my Lord said, "Speak, and I will hear you," and I then began to say unto Him, "Thus have I spoken unto Him." After I was humbled from my glory, those who have been warned shall be with me in my affliction.

But if they are unwilling to heed me, and they do not listen to me, to perform your commandment, and to fulfill your will, and to keep your word, and they do not keep my commandment, as I have taught them, in the time they are unwilling, I too will be as they have not heeded me; let them be for your kingdom; and if you loved me in the time you gave me, let them take that which you have given me.
Let them not be cast out from me, and let not the demons speak against them; let them give my beloved unto them; and let them be placed at your right hand, empty from me and my hosts.

As you have loved me, let them praise you; let them be as I am and as your hosts are; for you have troubled me, and my power has been diminished because of those whom you have loved, and their power has been exalted. Therefore, let them praise you as you have loved me.
And my Lord returned and said to me, "Behold, while they are seeing and hearing, you have despised my work, and let it be according to your will and according to your word."
Do not turn away my command and the word of the scribes; when they come to you, their destruction shall not grieve me; and you shall remain with them in hell because of your deceit.
Until the age of ages, there is no escape from hell for you and for those who are with you. However, for eternity, you shall be tormented in the fire.

"But thou, like my servant Job, shall I lift up thy throne in glory; for thou shalt say unto those who are afflicted, 'I shall give you the kingdom of heaven,' saith the Almighty, who is able to do all things."

"I also shall be a comfort to the children of Adam; for if it be possible for me to comfort them, they shall not be forsaken in their good works; for I shall comfort all the children of Adam, and I shall fulfill their desires of the world."
"In the giving of bread, in the giving of drink, in the giving of clothing, and in the giving of things, whether in bestowing or in taking away,"
"In the hearing and in the seeing, whether in the giving of counsel or in the going forth, whether in the pride and in the abundance of things, whether in sleep and in dreams,"
"In the giving of drink and in the abundance of strong drink, whether in the increase of wrath and anger, whether in the speaking of folly and jest,"
"In the taking of their neighbors, whether in the keeping of the good, whether in the seeing of the beautiful women of this world, whether in the taking of the garments of the poor,"

"I shall bring destruction upon them all, for they cannot escape; and because of them, I shall bring calamity upon the place where I have taken refuge, and I shall keep them from the path of the Lord."

"And the prophet said, 'Thou art foolish and proud! In thy pride and in the hardness of thy heart, thou dost provoke thy Creator; and thou dost turn away from the command of the Lord, and in thy time thou shalt be judged by the creation of the Lord.'"

"When thy Creator is angry with thee for thy wicked deeds, why dost thou take upon thyself the work which was created from the earth and from the dust, and why dost thou bear the burden of the one who was formed for glory?"
"Thou art but a shadow; I am thy Creator, who formed thee from the fire and from the wind, and in this time I say unto thee,"

Thou also, in the time of Thy visitation, O Lord God, didst regard the evil of thy work; and without being angry, Thou didst cause us to give thanks to Thy name, for Adam was created to give thanks unto Thee; and with Thy hosts, we do glorify the Lord.

Adam and his sons, because of Thy pride, did in their lamentation give thanks unto the name of the Lord, both for themselves and for Thy hosts; they were created, for they were more than all the archangels.

Therefore, the Lord God, as Thou art, didst separate thee from all the leaders of the angels; for thou and thy hosts were created in one counsel, and because they are of no avail, and because of your hearts' pride and your minds' arrogance, ye shall not ascend unto the glory of the Lord; but rather, ye shall be cast down upon your Creator.
Therefore, in humility, let us give thanks, for Adam was created from the earth; and He commanded him not to eat of the fruit of the tree of knowledge.

And over all that He created, He commanded, saying: "Of every tree in the garden thou mayest freely eat; but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it, for in the day that thou eatest thereof, thou shalt surely die."
And this word, when thou hearest it, shall be as a wound upon the side of Adam, which was found upon Eve.
As thou also dost make the law to be a burden, so in the evil of thy pride, thou dost cause the innocent to be afflicted.

As a woman in travail, who knows not her travail, so didst thou cause Eve to be deceived; and in the deed that was done, thou didst lead her astray; and this was the first creation that was made, and she was led away from the earth, the first creation of God, Adam.
In thy pride, thou didst add to the blow that was not fitting; and thou didst cause the word of the Creator to be broken; and in thy pride, thou didst destroy the humble.
In thy deception, thou didst draw away from the love of the Creator; and because of thee, thou didst cast out joy from paradise; and in thy deceit, thou didst forget the feast of paradise.

In thy falsehood, thou hast caused me to drink from the cup of hell; for thou art a thief, and shouldst be cast down to Sheol, rather than dwell in true existence. The love of my God shall be revealed, for from ancient times thou hast been ensnared by the vanity of man.
Being earthly, he honored his Creator with his soul and body, and with his heart he rendered spiritual and articulate praise.
As in the spring, He created ten minds that give thanks in various diverse forms.
To Thee, O Creator, as I send forth my prayers, I offer my gratitude for the thought that Thou hast instilled within me.
Yet unto Adam were given ten thoughts, five that were evil and five that were good.

And the thoughts of man are many, like the waves of the sea; and as the wind blows upon the earth, so do thoughts arise within him, like the multitude of waves that cannot be numbered. The thoughts of Adam are thus, as they are uncountable, like the rain that falls upon the heart.
But thy thought, O man, is but one; it is not carnal, and there is no other thought beside it.

Yet thou, having hearkened to the serpent, didst become one body with Adam, and through the evil counsel of the serpent, thou wast led astray; and Eve also hearkened to the words of the serpent; and she did as she was commanded.

And the Lord God, in the beginning of creation, did cause Adam to partake of the fruit of the forbidden tree; and because she transgressed the command of her Creator, she brought death upon herself and upon her children.

And the true judgment of God cast them out from paradise; and they were driven forth from the garden. Nevertheless, in the land to which they were cast out, they did eat of the fruit of their children and of the land.

And in the time when Thou didst cast them out from paradise, O Lord God, Thou didst give them trees that were not found in the garden; that they might be nourished by the fruit which Thou didst provide in the garden and the fruit of the earth.

In seeing their children, their hearts were greatly rejoiced by the fruit of the earth, which was hidden from them; and in the time of abundance, if they were cast out from paradise, they would be filled with sorrow.
And the Lord knoweth how to sustain His creation, and their hearts shall be filled with joy by the fruit of their children and of the earth.
And unto this land of the wicked and of the oppressor, they have been driven away; and their hearts shall be filled with sorrow and with water.
ጌታውም አዳምን ይቤዠው ዘንድ አለው፤ አንተንም ያሳፍርሃል፤ በጉንም ከተኵላ አፍ ያድነዋል።
ነገር ግን አንተ የገዛሃቸውን ሰዎች ከአንተ ጋር ይዘህ ወደ ጥፋት ትሄዳለህ።
የፈጣሪያቸው የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ የጠበቁ ግን የእርሱ እድል ፋንታ ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ፥ የፈጣሪያቸው የእግዚአብሔርንም ሕግ እንዳንተ ካልተላለፉ ከቅዱሳን መላእክቱ ጋር ያመሰግኑት ዘንድ ከክፉ ሥራህ ከሰወራቸው ከፈጣሪያቸው ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ደስ ይላቸዋል።
አንተ ግን ከመላእክቱ ጋራ ታመሰግነው ዘንድ እንደ አንተ ካሉት ሁሉ ይልቅ መርጦ የሰጠህ እግዚአብሔር በትዕቢትህ ከፍ ያለ ዙፋንን ነሳህ።
አንተም ታበይህ፤ ዲያብሎስም ተባልህ፤ ሠራዊቶችህም አጋንንት ተባሉ።
እግዚአብሔርን የሚወዱ ግን እንደ ቅዱሳን መላእክት ለእርሱ ወገኖቹ ይሆናሉ፤ የሚያመሰግኑት ሱራፌልና ኪሩቤልም ክንፎቻቸውን ዘርግተው ያለማቋረጥ ያመሰግናሉ።
አንተ ግን በመልክህ ከተፈጠሩ ከነገድህና ከሠራዊትህ ጋር ሁልጊዜ ታመሰግነው ዘንድ ምስጋናህን በትዕቢትህና በስንፍናህ አጠፋህ።
እንደ አንተ ያለ መፍጠር የማይቻለው መስሎህ አንተ የፈጠረህ የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋና በዘነጋህ ጊዜ፥ ዐሥረኛ ነገድ አድርጎ የፈጠረህ የእግዚአብሔር ምስጋናው እንዳይጐድል አንተም ከወንድሞችህ አንድነት በተለየህ ጊዜ የፈጠረህ የእግዚአብሔር ምስጋናው እንዳይጐድል፥
አንተም በልቡናህ ትዕቢት የፈጠረህ የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋና ቸል ባልህ ጊዜ፥ እርሱም በተቈጣህና፤ በተዘባበተብህ ጊዜ፤ ከሠራዊቶችህም ጋራ በገሃነም እንቅጥቅጥ በአጋዘህ ጊዜ
በቅዱሳት እጆቹ ከምድር መሬትን ወሰደ፤ ውኃንና እሳትን፥ ነፋስንም ጨመረ፤ አዳምንም በመልኩና በምሳሌው ፈጠረው።
Let the praise return to Thee, O Lord, for all creation which Thou hast made by Thy hand. The praise of the earth is joined with the praise of the heavens; their praises are equal.
Yet Thou, in Thy pride and in the haughtiness of Thy heart, hast been cast down; having departed from the lordship of the Lord God, Thou hast destroyed Thyself.
That the praise of the Lord may not be lost, the Lord hastens to grant the counsel that He may be praised, that the praise may not be lost; know this.

He knows all things without doing anything, and His command is known to you without His hastening; before the world was created, there was counsel with Him, and in His time, He created man in His image and likeness.
Solomon said, "Before the mountains were born, and before the earth and the world were formed,
before the dwelling places of the mountains and the hills were established, and before the world’s paths were laid, before the sun and the moon gave light, before the stars and the ages were known,
before night and day were distinguished, before the sea was established, before all creatures were created,
today, that which is seen was not seen, today, that which is named was not named, saying, 'He created me,' as it was spoken; you and the angels who are like you were in the mind of God.
In Thy time, O Holy One, may Thy name be praised; and also in this time, may we be praised by the one created from the earth, Adam, who was created by Thee.
The Lord hears the prayers of the needy from afar; for the Lord loves the praise of those who are afflicted.
እግዚአብሔር የትዕቢተኞችን ነገር ቸል ይላል፥ የፈረስን ኀይል አይወድምና፥ በሰው ጕልበትም ደስ አይለውምና።
ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር በሚፈሩትና ስለ ኀጢአታቸው ጩኸው በሚያለቅሱ ደስ ይለዋል።
አንተ በንስሓ መናዘዝ ተሳነህ።
ያ መሬት ግን ስለ ኀጢአቱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ፈጽሞ እያለቀሰ በንስሓ ተመለሰ።
አንተስ በልብህ ትዕቢትና በአንገትህ መደንደን የሰላም መንገድን አላወቅሃትም፥ ንስሓንም አላወቅሃትም፥ በንስሓ፥ በልቅሶና በእንባ በፈጣሪህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መናዘዝ ተሳነህ።
ያ አመድና መሬት የሆነ ድሃ ግን በልቅሶና በእንባ ወደ ንስሓ፥ ወደ ሰላምና ወደ ትሕትና መንገድ ተመለሰ።
አንተስ ለፈጠረህ ለእግዚአብሔር ራስህንና የልብህን ቀፈት አላዋረድህም።
እርሱ ግን በበደለው በደል ራሱን አዋርዶ ተናዘዘ፤ አልታበየምም።
ያንም ስሕተት የፈጠረው እርሱ አይደለም። ከአንተ የተገኘ ነው እንጂ፥ ወንጀልን ፈጥረህ አውጥተኸዋልና። በትዕቢትህም ከአንተ ጋራ ወደ አንተ ጥፋት ወሰድኸው።
ሁለታችሁን ሁሉ ሳይፈጥራችሁ ዐውቋችኋልና፥ አካሄዳችሁንም ዐውቋልና ይህ የተደረገ በልብህ ትዕቢት እንደ ሆነ እርሱ ያውቃል።
That which is devoid of pride, yet returns with humility, with supplication and tears.
But thou, in thine heart, art filled with pride, and hast been led astray by arrogance. A man who is not led astray by pride is more righteous than he who has been previously led astray.

Nevertheless, before the Creator, before God, he who is led astray and who is humbled, he truly enters into humility; and he finds the way of his Lord, which shall soften the heart of the Lord; and before the Lord, he is humbled; and the Lord shall rebuke his servant, that he may be cleansed from his former transgressions.
And if he does not return to the former state of sin, this is indeed perfect humility. Adam did not forget his Creator, nor did he become arrogant before his Creator.
Thou also, in humility, be humbled before thy Creator; do not exalt thyself over Him and over the work of His hands; for they are flesh and blood, and the God who created them knows their weaknesses.
Their souls shall be a refuge until the day of their release, even after their flesh has perished.

Remember thy Creator; do not forsake the Holy One of Israel, who sustains and protects thee; thou art made from the earth, and in thy form and likeness thou hast been created, and may it bring thee joy, for thou dwellest in the garden.
When thou dost transgress His command, then from paradise He shall cast thee out, and for thy sake He shall bring thee to this earth of desolation.

Thou art earth, and she is earth; thou art a dwelling, and she is a dwelling; thou art land, and she is land, and from her thou shalt be taken; unto her thou shalt return; until thou art lifted up, thou shalt remain a dwelling, and all thy deeds of sin and iniquity shall be revealed unto thee.
Whenever thou dost return, consider the evil thou hast wrought in this world, and reflect upon the good; whether evil abounds or good prevails, let it be weighed.
If thou dost increase in good, on the day when the dead shall rise, may it bring thee joy and gladness, for it shall be well with thee.

But if thou dost increase in evil, woe unto thee; as thy hands have wrought, and as thy heart, so shalt thou receive thy recompense, and as thou hast done unto thy neighbor, so shall it be done unto thee, and thou shalt not fear God.
If thou dost deceive thy neighbor, and in the name of God speak falsehood, as thy deeds, so shalt thou receive thy recompense.
By making thy words to thy neighbor a lie, thou shalt cause them to be true; but thou shalt know that thou hast spoken falsehood.

With those who are with thee, while thou dost deceive them, thy word shall be considered true; and that which is not true thou shalt increase; as thy deeds, so shalt thou receive thy recompense; and thou shalt say, “I shall give to my neighbor,” and thou shalt deceive him.

I shall give thee a pure heart; in thy time, thy neighbor shall seek thee as dogs seek their prey; all shall be laid bare before thee; if thou dost rise, thou shalt give, and if thou dost love, thou shalt not be lacking; and the money of this world shall be a snare unto thee; “They shall be ensnared; they know not the one who ensnares them,” thus it is said.
And it is said, "The children of Adam, the deceitful ones, shall make the balance deceitful; they shall go from vanity to vanity."

O people, as you ponder the balance and the scales, do not increase your wealth by the means of another's money, nor by the oppression of another's field; for in all that you do to gain profit for yourselves, do not let hope in the judgment deceive you.
If you do this, you shall receive according to your works.
O people, let your work be grounded in your own hands, and do not trust in falsehood; do not devour the money of others through unjust judgment and deceit.
Even if you devour, it shall not benefit you; and if you oppress, at the time of your death, you shall leave it for another, yet it shall not profit you.

And if your wealth increases, let not your hearts be lifted up; for the wealth of the wicked shall vanish like smoke, and the breath shall depart like a fleeting mist; indeed, it is better to have a little with righteousness than much with the wealth of many wicked.
Consider the day of your death; when your soul shall depart from your body, and when you shall leave your wealth to another, and when you shall walk on a path you know not, ponder these things.
Those who receive you are wicked; they are evil in their goodness; they are those who will cause you to be in need; they will not listen to your words, nor shall you listen to their words.
Because you have not done according to the will of your God, the Lord, in the time of your transgressions, they shall not return to you; therefore, you are greatly in need.
For the wicked shall be in need, but those who do the will of God shall have no fear. Even the souls of the wicked shall be in need.
This world, because of its wickedness, brings great joy to the righteous; the souls of the righteous shall be honored by the angels; but the souls of the wicked shall be received by evil spirits.

The souls of the righteous shall be sent by God, for they shall be received by the angels of mercy; but the souls of the wicked shall be received by evil spirits, for they shall be tormented by the wicked.
Woe unto you, for the day of your death shall not come upon you unawares; the time that follows your death shall not return.
But when you come before the Lord, you shall dwell without sorrow and without weeping, that your time may pass in joy, and you shall enter into the rest of your Lord.

Let it not be that a vain will shall be upon you from the Lord; in your steadfastness and your dwelling, you shall not find food and joy; for a body that is unclean shall not think of the name of the Lord, but the spirit of the devil shall possess it, and the spirit of life shall not dwell in it.
Moses said, "Jacob went forth and was preserved; he was blessed, and he was favored, for he had turned away from the Lord God who created him."
And life is far from God, as it has been said; it is like a horse that has no proper saddle, for it is to be without proper eating and drinking, and to be in despair like a wilderness is to be.
But he who eats in moderation shall be established upon the foundation of God; as a stone is firm, so shall the wall be established. "The sinner shall flee without being pursued," it is said.
The righteous, however, shall dwell like a lion.
Those who do not love the Lord do not keep His word; their hearts are not at rest.

And the Lord, while upon the earth, that they may not stumble, through trembling and fear, and by the shaking of their wealth, and in great distress, they shall be seized by the hand of their oppressors.
Let them not be delivered from their affliction, nor let their turmoil be in peace; while various afflictions that cause them distress abound, sorrow and destruction shall come upon them.
David said, "I have trusted in the Lord; I shall not fear; what can man do to me?" Thus, among those who trust in the Lord, there is neither fear nor terror.

He also said, "Though armies encamp against me, my heart shall not fear; though war arise against me, in this I will be confident; I seek Him, for he who trusts in Him shall dwell in life forever and shall not fear any evil."
Who is the man that trusts in the Lord? Who is the one that calls upon Him with a sincere heart?
"I will love those who love me; and those who seek me diligently shall find me; and I will keep safe those who return to me." Thus, who is the man that trusts in Him and places his hope in Him?

Preserve the body of your beloved; may the Lord deliver you from all that troubles you; keep watch over you; and after you, He shall protect your children; for the children of the righteous shall be blessed; they shall not be forsaken, nor shall they beg for bread.

Job believed in the Lord; for he knew that the Creator, the Lord, is worthy of praise, and that when the adversary, the devil, brought upon him all manner of affliction, he did not let his heart be troubled; but he said, "The Lord gave, and the Lord has taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord."
And the Lord, seeing that Job's heart was pure, received him with great honor.
He gave him wealth greater than that which he had before; for he had become exceedingly patient, and concerning all the afflictions that had befallen him, he was delivered from his distress.
Likewise, if you are beset by adversaries who come against you, you shall be righteous.
Be righteous; for the Lord shall be a refuge for you and for your children and for your children's children, that your hearts be not troubled by the afflictions that come upon you.
Trust in Him, for He shall be your refuge; He is good, and He shall hear you; hope in Him, for He shall have mercy upon you; for to those who trust in Him, He shall be a Father.
Esther and Mordecai, Judith and Gideon, Barak and Deborah, Samson and Jephthah,
For those who have trusted in the Lord, their adversaries shall not prevail against them, and think of others who are like them.
The Lord is true; He does not turn His face away, nor does He do evil to those who are beloved; but He keeps the souls of those who fear Him and do righteousness; He grants them honor and abundance.
In their coming and going, in their death and in their life; in their sitting and in their rising, He rejoices over them; for He shall deliver them and protect them.
He shall have mercy; He shall say, "Forgive."
He shall protect; He shall act with grace; He shall lift up, and He shall honor.
Whether in heaven or on earth, whether small or great, all is His; all shall dwell securely under His command.
There is no creator of the world who sends forth law and command; if there be a search for the spirit in heaven, He alone shall guide the way to the destination.
Even the path of the serpent within the world, He alone knows the way to the destination; and the path of the ship in the sea, apart from God, none knows it.
Whether the soul of the righteous or the soul of the wicked, after it has been separated from its body, there is none who knows the way it shall take except God alone.
Who knows the way you shall go in the wilderness or upon the mountain? As a bird soars, if you were to soar upon the mountain, who would know how you descend upon the heights?
As a fleeting breath, so it may be; the path may be as a flame that consumes, so it may be.
As the stars shine upon the heights, so it may be; as the sea roars in the midst of the waves, so it may be.
In the depths of the sea, as a rock stands firm, so it may be; as the waters flow forth, as the tree bears fruit, so it may be.
As the sun sets, and the wind blows to another place, as the search may not be found, so it may be; the search may not be found, as a fleeting shadow, so it may be. Who knows?
Who knows the way of the Lord? Who are the mighty? With whom do they contend?
የእግዚአብሔር አሳቡ ከሰው የተሰወረ ነውና ፍለጋውን ማን ይከተላል?
የእግዚአብሔርን ምክሩንና ጥበቡን መመርመር የሚችል ማን ነው? እርሱ ምድርን በውኃ ላይ መሥርትዋታልና፥ ያለካስማም አጽንትዋታልና፥ በፍጹም ጥበቡም ሰማይን በነፋስ አጸናው፤ ተባዕታዊውንም ውኃ እንደ ድንኳን ዘረጋው።
ደመናትንም በምድር ላይ ዝናምን ያዘንሙ ዘንድ አዘዛቸው፤ ሣርንም ያበቅላል፤ በእግዚአብሔርም በአንድነት ደስ ይለን ዘንድ ለሰው ምግብ ሊሆኑ ቍጥር የሌላቸው ፍሬዎችን ያበቅላል።
እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ልጆች በረከቱን ሁሉ፥ ደስታውንና ጥጋቡንም ይሰጣቸዋል ይኸውም ጠግበው ከምድር ፍሬ የሰጣቸውን እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑት ዘንድ ነው።
የአማረ መጐናጸፊያንም ያለበሳቸውን፥ የሚፈለገውንም በረከት ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ ለሚፈጽሙ ሰዎች የተሰጠ ደስታውንና ተድላውንም ይሰጣቸዋል።
የእግዚአብሔርንም ትእዛዝ ለሚጠብቁ፥ ለአባቶቻቸው በአዘጋጀው ማደሪያ በሰማያት ክብርንና መወደድን ደስታንም ይሰጣቸዋል።
በአምልኮቱና በፍርዱ ለኖሩ፥ ሕጉን ይጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ ሥርዐቱንም ይሹ ዘንድ ለጠበቃቸውና ለመገባቸው፥ ለአሳደጋቸውና ለአከበራቸው፥ ከእርሱም ትእዛዝ ላልወጡ ክብርንና ሞገስን ይሰጣቸዋል፤ እኔም ጠላቶቻቸውን በማድከም፥ ሰውነታቸውንም በመጠበቅ እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ዓለም ለወዳጆቹ የሚያደርገውን አየሁ።
ሁሉንም እንደ ለመኑት ይሰጣቸዋል፥ ፈቃዳቸውንም ይፈጽምላቸዋል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ አትውጡ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ፈቃድ ፈጽሙ።
እንዳይቈጣባችሁ፥ በአንድ ጊዜም እንዳያጠፋችሁ፥ በቍጣውም እንዳይገርፋችሁ፥ ቀድሞ ከነበራችሁበት ከአባቶቻችሁ ርስትም እንዳትወጡ፥ ማደሪያችሁም እስከ ዘለዓለሙ ድረስ መውጫ በሌለበት በገሃነም እንዳይሆን ከትእዛዙና ከሕጉ አትውጡ።
በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በቆማችሁ ጊዜ ሥራችሁ በጎ ይሆን ዘንድ ነፍሳችሁ ከሥጋችሁ ሳትለይ የፈጣሪያችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ ጠብቁ።
The kingdom of heaven and the kingdom of earth is for Him alone; for He is the source of all majesty, and the kingdom is His alone; the power and the glory are also solely His.
He shall act with grace; He shall protect, He shall deliver, and He shall honor.
And David spoke concerning Him, saying, "Man is like a breath; his days are as a shadow that passeth away."
"O Lord, Thou art eternal; Thy name is called from generation to generation."
And the prophet said, "Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom; Thy dominion is from generation to generation," for Thou didst take the kingdom from Saul and give it to David.
Yet there is none that can contend with Thee; there is none that can prevail against Thee; there is none that can behold Thee; but Thou dost see all things.
Thy kingdom shall not be likened to any generation nor to the ages of eternity; there is none that can possess Him; yet He possesseth all things; He seeth all.

Let them give thanks with a pure heart and know their supplication; for from their creation and their coming forth, from their honor and their distress, except for the Lord God, let them not be as those who offer to other gods, for He created man in His likeness and in His image, and He will search their hearts and their thoughts.
But they have said, "We will not worship the Lord our God, for they offer to stone and wood, and the hand of man hath made them, and they shall offer to silver and gold."
And there they shall stand before God until their sacrifices ascend to heaven; and their idols, inasmuch as they have worshipped them, their iniquities shall be upon them.

They did not keep the commandments of the Lord God, but for the sake of idols, they engaged in all manner of wickedness, including the worship of stars, the invocation of spirits and idols, the practice of evil deeds, and all works that the Lord abhors.

That they may be delivered from sin and wickedness, and may be worthy to give praise before the Lord and the angels, for they do not desire to give thanks to the Lord, and in the absence of good works, they shall do all things.
When they rise together from the grave where they were buried, their souls shall stand before the Lord, and their spirits shall dwell in the houses of light prepared for the righteous.
But the souls of the wicked shall dwell in darkness; and when the graves are opened, their bodies shall rise; and their souls shall return to their former bodies.
As they were born, so shall their bodies stand before the Lord; from their infancy until that time, their sins shall be revealed.
They shall carry their sins upon their backs; whether few or many, if they have committed sin, they shall receive according to their works.
The souls of the dead shall rise as the winter wind blows; hear this, for the Spirit of the Lord shall breathe upon them as He did before.
Even unto death, He has called them by His word.
Their flesh shall decay, yet they shall rise as if they have been awakened; and they shall be filled with joy.
And in the time of resurrection, when the earth shall tremble, they shall rise; and they shall dwell as they were created.

The living souls that dwell upon the earth, and all that are sustained by water, He has called forth, and they were created; for the Spirit of the Lord was hovering over the waters; by His Spirit and His word, the living souls shall be given unto them.

Do not say that the dead do not rise; you who are of a hardened heart, until you look upon them; for by His Spirit and His word, they shall be created as a father and a mother; if you have wisdom, how can you say that the dead do not rise by the word of their Creator, the Lord?
Return to your understanding; and return to your faith; for the dead who are in the grave shall rise by the word of the Lord.
As it was spoken before, by the Lord, they shall rise by grace; and that word shall raise all the dead as if they have been awakened.
Arise, and stand before Him; know this: as your thoughts remain in the grave, do not let them deceive you.
Thus it is not; whether good or evil, as you have done upon the earth, you shall receive your due; for this is the day of reckoning.

In the time of resurrection, thou shalt receive thy debt for all thy sins committed; from thy childhood until this time, thou shalt be freed from the debt that is written against thee; and concerning thy sins, there is no reason for thee to be troubled, for this world is not a cause for thy transgressions.
Thy false words before thee, as thou dost speak the truth, even the lies thou dost utter are as truth in thy sight; in this, there is no reason for thee to be troubled.
She, being aware of all the evil deeds thou hast committed, and since she doth reveal thee before her Creator, before God, the word of God shall speak unto thee.

Therein, concerning thy sins, thou shalt be troubled; for it is with the righteous that thou shalt be praised, and not in the day of judgment, lest thou be troubled before angels and men; therefore, strive to enter into this repentance.

Those who give praise to God along with the angels shall receive their reward from their Creator; they shall be filled with joy; however, while thou art in the flesh, if thou hast not done good works, thou shalt have no share with the righteous.
While thou hast knowledge, and thy worth and price are not prepared, and while thou hast money, thou shalt not assist the needy; thus, it shall be a silent cry that shall be upon thee.
While thou art clothed, thou shalt not be naked; and while thou hast power, thou shalt not be cast down.

While thou hast knowledge, return to repentance; for in times past, the sins committed in ignorance, God shall forgive; thus, the wicked man shall not be taught; and while thou hast strength, do not contend with the weak.
While thou art strong, do not oppress the strength of thy childhood; for in this world, there is no flesh to boast of; do not exalt thyself above the righteous, nor be arrogant.
In the world, there is no joy in abundance, nor in delectable foods and in the passing of drink; nor in fine clothing, nor in gold and silver adornments.
በከበሩ በሕንደኬ ዕንቍዎች፥ በጳዝዮንና በመረግድ አይደለም፤ ይህ የሚገባ የሰው ጌጥ አይደለም።
ለሰውስ ጌጡ ንጽሕና፥ ጥበብና ዕውቅት፥ ያለ መቅናትና ያለ ምቀኝነት፥ ያለ መጠራጠርና ያለ ጠብ በሚገባ መዋደድ ነው።
ባልንጀራህን እንደ ራስህ እየወደድህ፥ ክፉ ባደረገብህ ሰውም ክፉ ነገር ሳታደርግ፥ መከራውን ለታገሡ ሰዎች ወደ ተሰጠ ማደሪያም ትገባ ዘንድ፥ ቅድስት ምድርን በትዕግሥትና በዕውቀት፥ በትንሣኤም ጊዜ መንግሥተ ሰማይን ተስፋ በማድረግ ከወረስዋት ሰዎች ጋር ዋጋህን ይሰጥህ ዘንድ ነው።
“ከሞትን በኋላ አንነሣም” አትበሉ፤ ይኽን የሚናገሩና የሚያስቡ ሰዎችን በትንሣኤ ጊዜ እንዳይድኑ ዲያብሎስ ተስፋ ያስቈርጣቸዋልና፥ ትንሣኤም በደረሰችባቸው ጊዜ ያውቃሉ፤ ኀጢአታቸውን ያስብባቸው ዘንድ ባለ ማወቅ ኀጢአት የሠሩ ሰዎች በትንሣኤ ጊዜ ፈጽመው ያዝናሉ፤ በዚያች ቀን እንደሚነሡ አላመኑበትምና።
ስለዚህም በምድር ላይ እንደ ሠሩት ሥራቸው ክፋት ይወቀሳሉ፤ በሥጋ በአንድነት የሚነሡባትን የካዷትንም ትንሣኤ ያዩአታል።
ሥራቸውንም ስላላሳመሩ ያንጊዜ ያለቅሳሉ፤ ቢቻላቸውስ በዚያ የሚያለቅሱ እንዳይሆኑ፥ በዚህ ዓለም ቢያለቅሱ በተሻላቸው ነበር።
በዚህ በፈቃዳችን ካላለቀስን፥ በዚያ ያለፈቃዳችን ያስለቅሱናል፤ በዚህ ንስሓን ካላዘጋጀን፥ በዚያ የማይረባና የማይጠቅም ጩኸትንና ልቅሶን እናዘጋጃለን።
ከሞት ወደ ሕይወት፥ ከምታልፍ ከዚህች ዓለምም ወደ ላይኝ`ዋ መንግሥተ ሰማይ፥ ከዚች ምድራዊት ብርሃንም ወደ ሰማያዊት ብርሃን ትሸጋገሩ ዘንድ መልካም ሥራን አዘጋጁ።
የሙታን ትንሣኤን ከሚያምኑ ሰዎች ጋር በማያልቅ ደስታ በመንግሥተ ሰማይ ደስ ይልህ ዘንድ በምድር ያለች ደስታን እንቢ በላት፤ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘለዓለም አሜን።
